metric_unit: 8 intents / policy, original fixed Chinese text and qrels
timing: Every auto request retranslates Chinese, then retrieves; record translation/retrieval/actual total with GPU sync. Models/index loading excluded from warm request, separately measured. Rotate policy order for each intent/round.
english_reference_usage: Existing hand-authored English is never fed to translator or used to edit output. Prior provided-English results are descriptive controls only.
